title_en: About 90% of Your Body Was Made Inside Stars #Shorts
desc_en:
By mass your body is about 65% oxygen, 18% carbon, 10% hydrogen and 3% nitrogen. The hydrogen dates from the Big Bang; most of the rest was forged in stars.

Source: NASA Chandra X-ray Observatory, "Elements in the human body" (2019).
Directed by L.S.M · Dreamloom Studio (Heosang Gongbang)

#shorts #science
desc_ko:
몸무게 기준으로 몸은 산소 약 65%, 탄소 18%, 수소 10%, 질소 3%입니다. 수소는 빅뱅 때 생겼고, 나머지 대부분은 별 속에서 만들어졌습니다.

출처: NASA 찬드라 X선 관측소, "Elements in the human body"(2019)
연출 L.S.M · 허상공방
